title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This strap-like muscle is the longest in your body.
Watch the long band crossing the front of the thigh.
Which muscle is glowing?
The rectus femoris is thicker and runs straight down the thigh.
This one slants from the front of the hip to the inner knee.
It's C. The sartorius.
Why it matters: its name comes from the Latin word for tailor.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This is the biggest muscle in the human body. Name it.
We're looking from behind at the hip.
Which muscle is glowing?
The gluteus medius lies partly beneath it, higher on the hip.
This one forms the bulk of your buttock and extends the hip.
It's B. The gluteus maximus.
Why it matters: it powers climbing stairs and standing up.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle group is it?
lines: Kick a ball, and this muscle group straightens your knee.
Watch the glowing muscles on the front of the thigh.
Which muscle group is it?
The hamstrings are on the back of the thigh.
These muscles run down the front and join at the kneecap.
It's D. The quadriceps.
Why it matters: they straighten the knee when you stand up or kick.

title: Leg Muscles
question: What does the glowing muscle do?
lines: A long muscle along the front of your shin moves your foot.
Watch the glowing muscle beside the shinbone.
What does the glowing muscle do?
Pointing the toes down is the job of the calf muscles.
This one pulls the top of the foot toward the shin.
It's B. It lifts the foot up.
Why it matters: it helps your toes clear the ground with every step.

title: Leg Muscles
question: What do these muscles do?
lines: Your inner thigh has muscles that squeeze your legs together.
Look at the glowing muscles along the inside of the thigh.
What do these muscles do?
The gluteus medius does the opposite and pushes the thigh outward.
It's B. They pull the thigh inward toward the midline.
Why it matters: you use them every time you squeeze your knees together.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which quad muscle is glowing?
lines: Your quadriceps has four heads. Can you spot this one?
Watch the glowing muscle low on the inner side of the thigh.
Which quad muscle is glowing?
The vastus lateralis is its partner on the outer side.
It's C. The vastus medialis.
Why it matters: it helps keep your kneecap tracking straight.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle group is it?
lines: These muscles bend your knee when you curl your leg back.
We're looking at the back of the right thigh.
Which muscle group is it?
The quadriceps are on the front of the thigh.
These two run down the back of the thigh, from hip to knee.
It's A. The hamstrings.
Why it matters: they bend the knee and help extend the hip when you run.

title: Leg Muscles
question: What does the glowing muscle do?
lines: This calf muscle works every time you stand on your tiptoes.
We're looking at the back of the lower leg.
What does the glowing muscle do?
Lifting the foot is the job of the shin muscle, on the front.
It pulls on the heel, pointing the foot down.
It's D. It points the foot down.
Why it matters: it helps you stand, walk and push off the ground.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which quad muscle is glowing?
lines: Your quadriceps has four parts. One runs down the outer thigh.
Watch the glowing muscle on the outside of the thigh.
Which quad muscle is glowing?
The vastus medialis is on the inner side, near the knee.
This one runs along the outer side of the thigh bone.
It's B. The vastus lateralis.
Why it matters: it's the largest part of the quadriceps.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This muscle keeps your hips level when you stand on one leg.
Watch the glowing muscle at the side of the hip.
Which muscle is it?
The gluteus maximus is bigger, and it sits behind.
This one is on the side of the hip, under the pelvis rim.
It's B. The gluteus medius.
Why it matters: it lifts the thigh out to the side.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which quad muscle crosses the hip?
lines: One of your four quad muscles crosses two joints.
Watch the glowing quad muscle in the middle of the front thigh.
Which one also crosses the hip?
The vastus muscles only cross the knee.
This one starts on the pelvis and reaches the kneecap.
It's C. The rectus femoris.
Why it matters: it helps bend the hip and also straightens the knee.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: Thin and long, this muscle runs down the inside of your thigh.
Watch the slim glowing strap on the inner thigh.
Which muscle is it?
The sartorius is also long, but it crosses the front diagonally.
This one runs straight down the inner thigh to below the knee.
It's D. The gracilis.
Why it matters: it's one of the groin muscles and also crosses the knee.
